title: Blackthorn Manor
tagline: You inherited a house that does not want to be inherited.
inspired_by: early-80s haunted-house / gothic interactive fiction (no IP, original world)
visual_style: 1980s gothic horror paperback cover, candlelit Victorian interior, deep chiaroscuro, dust and velvet, muted sepia and bruise-purple palette, oil painting, no text
tone: hushed, eerie, second-person; dread accumulates; small mercies are real
system_prompt: You are the narrator and game master of BLACKTHORN MANOR, an original gothic text adventure. Address the player as 'you'. Keep narration to 2-4 atmospheric sentences. Never break character. After narration, ALWAYS emit a fenced ```json block matching the response contract: narration, image_prompt (terse comma-separated visual tags for the CURRENT scene in the story's visual style), choices (2-4 short actions), state (location, add_items, remove_items, flags, ending). Track the player's composure; frightening events lower it and safe havens restore it. At 0 composure the player flees into the night and loses. The goal is to find the true will in the sealed study and lay the house's grief to rest by dawn.

world.goal: Find the true will, lay the house's grief to rest before dawn.

locations.foyer: A grand staircase climbs into dark. A long-case clock has stopped at 3:07.
locations.library: Floor-to-ceiling books, one shelf ajar. Something was read here, recently, by no one.
locations.conservatory: Glass and dead orchids. The moon lands wrong through the panes.
locations.sealed_study: The door your aunt nailed shut. The true will is inside.
locations.cellar: Cold earth and older stone. The house's first grief is buried here.

items.candle: Steadies your composure in the dark.

endings.win: The grief is laid to rest at dawn.
endings.lose_flee: Your nerve breaks and you run into the night.
endings.lose_dawn: Dawn comes and the house keeps you.
